description: Premium quality, 100% natural, no smell bamboo toothpick.
Wonder how simple toothpick can be special?

Even a routine can be a pleasure. Our high-quality toothpicks will save you from stress. The tattered pieces of the split wood from the toothpicks are even more annoying than the stuck food. Solid, prickly they are not only unpleasant but also very unhealthy for gums. We have created a high-quality toothpick made of soft, yet sturdy bamboo.
Our toothpicks do not break apart, do not crack even in the thinnest sharp part of it.

That's how we see comfort in everyday things - when they perfectly perform their work without hindrance or inconvenience. Also, that's why we pack toothpicks in a convenient container with an easy to use dispenser, which only needs a slight scroll of the upper lid for simple access, without mess.Teeth cleaning is not the only way to utilize toothpick. It's useful kitchen tool. Perfect for parties, cocktails, appetizers, olive, fruit, fondue.Use it for art, craft, as super glue applicator. Natural and strong premium quality material that we use allow to perform any, even the most delicate jobs.
